basic_details.job_title: RGCB Project Research Scientist I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The ICMR funded project "Functional studies on novel porin from Malaria parasite and its implications as a therapeutic drug target" at BRIC-Rajiv Gandhi Centre for Biotechnology (RGCB), Thiruvananthapuram, has one temporary Project Research Scientist - I position, paying ₹56,000/- + 20% HRA per month, initially for one year or till termination of the project whichever is earlier. Indian citizens with an MSc or equivalent degree in any branch of Life sciences with 70% marks, plus the experience listed below, can apply online (Advertisement No. 22/2026) by 8 December 2026.

age_limit.details: The age limit is 35 years as on 8 December 2026. Age relaxation will be given as per Govt. of India norms; the notice does not list the relaxation by category. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

how_to_apply: Submit the application online through the Apply Online link on the RGCB website.
Use the prescribed format; applications not in the prescribed format will summarily be rejected.
Candidates currently working in Government firms should send applications through proper channel.
If applying for different positions, submit a separate application form for each position.
Make sure the completed application is received by 8 December 2026.
The notice does not name any documents to attach.
important_instructions: Applications not in the prescribed format will summarily be rejected. Candidates currently working in Government firms should send applications through proper channel. A separate application form is needed for each position applied for. The position is co-terminus with the end of the project and gives no claim to future positions at RGCB. Contact: BRIC-Rajiv Gandhi Centre for Biotechnology, Thycaud Post, Poojappura, Thiruvananthapuram - 695 014, Kerala, India; phone +91-471-2529400 | 2347975 | 2348753; email [email protected].

content_sections.heading: About the Centre
content_sections.text: BRIC-Rajiv Gandhi Centre for Biotechnology (RGCB) is located at Thycaud Post, Poojappura, Thiruvananthapuram. The post is in the project of Dr. Mahendran K R, Scientist E-II at RGCB. It is a multi-institutional project in collaboration with Dr. Arumugam Rajavelu, Associate Professor, IIT Madras, and Prof. Jagannath Mondal, Associate Professor, Tata Institute of Fundamental Research, Hyderabad.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian citizens may apply for this post. The notice states that only those fulfilling the criteria below need apply. Minimum of 6 months of experience in Biophysical techniques One-year experience in molecular and cell biology techniques The age limit is 35 years as on 8 December 2026. Age relaxation will be given as per Govt. of India norms; the notice does not list the relaxation by category. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

rows.essential_qualification: MSc or equivalent degree in any branch of Life sciences, with 70% marks
rows.desirable: Should be able to perform molecular and cell biology techniques like PCR, Cloning, transformation, protein purification

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The appointment is initially for a period of one year or till termination of the project whichever is earlier. As with all project positions at RGCB, the position will be co-terminus with the end of the project. Selection to the position will not entitle the candidate to any future positions at RGCB (permanent or otherwise).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for RGCB Project Research Scientist - I
content_sections.text: Submit the application online through the Apply Online link on the RGCB website. Use the prescribed format; applications not in the prescribed format will summarily be rejected. Candidates currently working in Government firms should send applications through proper channel. If applying for different positions, submit a separate application form for each position. Make sure the completed application is received by 8 December 2026. The notice does not name any documents to attach.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applicants will be short listed for the online selection interview based on eligibility criteria. Selection of suitable candidates will be made based on qualifications and performance in the selection interview. The interview date is not specified in the notice.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in RGCB Adv. 22/2026?
faq.answer: There is one position of Project Research Scientist - I in the ICMR funded project at BRIC-RGCB, Thiruvananthapuram.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for RGCB Project Research Scientist - I?
faq.answer: The last date for receiving completed applications is 8 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for RGCB Project Research Scientist - I?
faq.answer: An MSc or equivalent degree in any branch of Life sciences with 70% marks, a minimum of 6 months of experience in Biophysical techniques and one-year experience in molecular and cell biology techniques.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 35 years as on 8 December 2026, with age relaxation as per Govt. of India norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of RGCB Project Research Scientist - I?
faq.answer: The emolument is ₹ 56,000/- + 20% HRA per month.

faq.answer: Yes. The notice gives the emolument as ₹ 56,000/- + 20% HRA per month.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Applications should be submitted online in the prescribed format. Applications not in the prescribed format will summarily be rejected.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Applicants are short listed for the online selection interview based on eligibility criteria. Selection is based on qualifications and performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. It is a temporary project position, initially for one year or till termination of the project whichever is earlier, and co-terminus with the end of the project.
